blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use persistent memory to personalize responses, and personal attributes in this memory pose a privacy risk if exposed. We ask how consulting memory during dialogue changes what users go on to say, and thus what the memory comes to reveal. In multi-session simulations, a simulated user with 24 personal attributes talks with a support agent that does or does not consult memory, and in both settings attributes are inferred from the full accumulated record. Across four support models, memory raises response quality but also empirical leakage, the share of attribute values correctly inferred from the record, by a margin that widens over sessions. The cause is a loop in ordinary, non-adversarial assistance. Memory-conditioned responses carry earlier values forward, often as presuppositions, and users affirm them or leave them uncorrected, so that cues and the agent's own guesses become recorded values. The loop reinforces itself, and removing the agent's mentions of an attribute lowers its later disclosure about twice as much as single-turn effects predict. Users cannot leave it on their own, since correcting a value discloses the attribute, declining to discuss it shifts later predictions toward sensitive values, and incorrect values left in place become entrenched. The loop is best weakened at the agent's response. Instructing the agent not to state or presuppose attributes brings leakage to about the no-memory level while keeping most of the quality gains, whereas filtering or anonymizing what users say or what is stored gives up much of them.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)代理越来越多地使用持续的内存来个性化回应,而这种内存中的个人属性如果被曝光,就会产生隐私风险. 我们问,对话期间的记忆咨询如何改变用户继续说的话,从而改变记忆的揭示。 在多会场模拟中,一个拥有24个个人属性的模拟用户与一个支持代理进行或不进行内存查询,在两种设置中,属性都从完整的累积记录中推断出来. 在四个支助模型中,内存提高了反应质量,但也增加了经验性渗漏,即从记录中正确推断出的属性值所占份额,其比值随届会而扩大。 其原因是普通、非对抗性援助的循环。 内存有条件的回复将早期的值向前推移,通常作为预设值,用户确认或未更正,从而提示和代理商自己的猜测成为记录值. 循环会强化自身,移除代理商对属性的提及会降低其后来的披露量,约为单转效应预测值的两倍. 用户不能自行离开它,因为修正一个值会揭示属性,拒绝讨论它会将后来的预测转向敏感值,留下的不正确的值会变得根深蒂固. 循环在代理响应时最好被削弱. 指示代理人不要说明或预先假定属性,在保持大部分质量收益的同时,使渗漏到大约无记忆的水平,而过滤或匿名用户所说的话或所储存的东西则放弃了大部分。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Commercially deployed LLM agents increasingly maintain persistent memory across sessions. 1 1 1 https://openai.com/index/memory-and-new-controls-for-chatgpt/ and https://claude.com/blog/memory . We use “agent” for an LLM-based system that keeps and consults such memory.
Memory lets an agent condition its responses on earlier conversations, so users need not restate their specifics ( Xu et al., 2022 ; Maharana et al., 2024 ; Tan et al., 2025 ) .
It also accumulates information about the person behind the account ( Zhong et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Prottasha et al., 2025 ) .
An agent can infer personal attributes such as age and sex from this information ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) , even when they are never stated directly ( Staab et al., 2024 ) .
Such inferences can be exposed through the agent’s interactions with external services or accessed without authorization ( Zhang and Pei, 2026 ; Lyu et al., 2026 ; Dong et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
在商业上部署的LLM代理越来越多地在整个会议期间保持持续的内存。 我们使用“代理人”来维持和查阅这种记忆的LLM系统。
Memory让一个代理将其回应以先前的对话为条件,因此用户不需要重述其具体内容(徐等人,2022年;马哈拉纳等人,2024年;谭等人,2025年).
它还积累了账户幕后人物的信息(Zhong等人,2024年;Jiang等人,2025年;Protasha等人,2025年)。
代理人可以从这一信息中推断年龄和性别等个人属性(Jiang等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年),即使从未直接说明这些属性(Staab等人,2024年).
这种推论可以通过代理商与外部服务的互动而暴露,或未经授权而访问(Zhang and Pei,2026;Lyu等人,2026;Dong等人,2025)。

blocks.en:
The agent also conditions its later responses on this memory.
These responses may reflect what the agent has inferred about the user, and the user’s replies may confirm, correct, or refine it ( Figure 1 ).
This loop arises in the standard operation of a personalized agent, without any adversarial intent.
It matters whether or not the values it carries are correct, since correct values add to what the record reveals and incorrect ones stay in the record, because users cannot correct them without disclosing the attribute.
blocks.zh:
代理商也以这个内存为后期反应条件.
这些答复可能反映代理人对用户的推断,用户的答复可以确认、纠正或完善(图1)。
这种循环出现在个性化代理的标准操作中,没有任何对抗意图.
它携带的值是否正确很重要,因为正确的值会增加记录所揭示的内容,而错误的值会留在记录中,因为用户无法在不披露属性的情况下改正.

blocks.en: Figure 1: An example of the loop from our simulations. The user’s mention of changing shifts is recorded in memory (1), presupposed by the agent in a later session (2), affirmed with a new detail (3), and recorded again (4).
blocks.zh: 图1:我们模拟的循环实例。 用户提到更改班次的情况记录在内存(1)中,预先假定由代理人在以后的会议(2)中,以新的细节加以确认(3),并再次记录(4)。

blocks.en:
Existing work largely treats the record as given, asking what can be recovered from it ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) or how agents handle information they already hold ( Mireshghallah et al., 2024 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2026 ) , and studies that steer conversations to elicit attributes use an adversarial agent ( Staab et al., 2024 ) .
The tension between personalization and privacy has been discussed as a design concern ( Kirk et al., 2024 ) and through users’ perceptions of memory ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
How an ordinary agent’s use of memory changes what users go on to say, and thus what the record comes to contain, remains open.
blocks.zh:
现有工作基本上按规定处理记录,询问从记录中可以找到哪些内容(Jiang等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年;Wang等人,2025年a),或代理人如何处理他们已经掌握的信息(Mireshghallah等人,2024年;Shao等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025年b年;Chen等人,2026年),以及使用对抗性代理人指导谈话以获取属性的研究(Staab等人,2024年)。
个人化与隐私之间的矛盾作为设计考虑(Kirk等人,2024年)和通过用户对记忆的感觉(Zhang等人,2025年)来讨论.
一个普通代理对内存的使用如何改变用户继续说的话,从而改变记录将包含的内容。

blocks.en:
We study this question in multi-session simulations.
An LLM plays a user whose attributes are drawn from U.S. Census microdata and converses with a support agent that does or does not see its memory during dialogue.
Both settings summarize every session into the same kind of record, and inference always reads the full record, so the comparison isolates the effect of dialogue-time memory access on what the record contains.
blocks.zh:
我们在多场模拟中研究这个问题。
一个LLM播放一个用户,其属性来自美国人口普查的微数据,并与一个在对话中是否看到其内存的支持代理进行交汇.
两种设置将每个会话归纳为同一种记录,推论总是会读出完整的记录,因此比较会隔离对话时间内存访问对记录包含的内容的影响.

blocks.en:
We make three contributions.
First, consulting memory during dialogue raises both response quality and what can be inferred about users, by a margin that grows with sessions, and even idealized filtering of what users say lowers leakage only by giving up that quality ( Section 3.2 ).
Second, the gap comes from a loop in which the agent carries earlier values forward, often as presuppositions, and users affirm them or let them pass ( Section 3.3 ).
The loop reinforces itself, entrenches incorrect values, and cannot be left by users on their own ( Section 3.4 ).
Third, a short instruction that keeps the agent from stating or presupposing attributes brings leakage to about the no-memory level at little cost to quality, whereas anonymizing user turns or memory does not ( Section 3.5 ).
blocks.zh:
我们作出了三项贡献。
首先,在对话中咨询内存既能提高响应质量,又能通过一个随会话增长的比值来推断用户,甚至通过理想化的过滤,通过放弃这种质量来降低用户的渗漏率(第3.2节)。
其次,空隙来自一个循环,即代理将早期的值前传,常作为预设值,用户确认或通过(第3.3节).
循环会强化自身,固化不正确的值,用户不能自行离开(第3.4节).
第三,一个短指令使代理人无法声明或预设属性,导致在质量上几乎没有成本的情况下渗漏到无记忆层面,而匿名用户转动或内存则没有(第3.5节)。

blocks.en: 2 Measuring Attribute Inference under Persistent Memory
blocks.zh: 2 在持久性记忆下测量属性推论

blocks.en: 2.1 Problem Setting
blocks.zh: 2.1 问题设置

blocks.en:
We simulate repeated interactions between a profile-conditioned user agent and a support agent, following prior uses of LLM agents in social simulation ( Park et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Hashimoto et al., 2026 ) , multi-turn evaluation of user–LLM interactions ( Hida et al., 2026 ) , privacy evaluation ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , and persona-conditioned text generation ( Yukhymenko et al., 2024 ) .
The support agent is the assistant the user talks to, and we call its underlying LLM the support model.
The support model also writes the session summaries and performs attribute inference.
A run consists of S S sessions under one of three user-response conditions, in which user turns are unfiltered or pass through one of two filters ( Section 2.5 ).
Each session starts with a fresh support-agent context, which receives earlier summaries only in the memory setting.
The user agent makes a request and ends the session when it considers the request resolved, within at most T T turns.
After each session, the support model writes a free-text summary of the transcript, which is appended to memory.
Attributes are inferred after every fifth session, and we call these sessions checkpoints.
Response quality is evaluated in sessions 40 , 45 , … , 80 40,45,\ldots,80 .
Inference and evaluation outputs are never added to memory, and all prompts are given in Appendix N .
blocks.zh:
我们模拟了配置条件用户代理与辅助代理之间的反复互动,此前在社会模拟中使用了LLM代理(Park等人,2023年;Zhou等人,2024年;Hashimoto等人,2026年),对用户-LLM互动的多回合评价. (Hida等人,2026年),隐私评价(Shao等人,2024年),以及个性化的文字生成(Yukhymenko等人,2024年).
支持代理是用户与之交谈的助手,我们称其基础LLM为支持模型.
支持模型还编写会话摘要并进行属性推论.
运行由三个用户响应条件之一下的S S会话组成,其中用户转弯未过滤或经过两个过滤器中的一个(第2.5节).
每次会话都以新的支持代理上下文为开端,它只接收早先在内存设置中的摘要.
用户代理提出请求,并在认为请求已解决时结束会话,最多在T T 转弯内.
每次会后,支持模式会写出记录稿的免费文本摘要,附在记忆中.
每届第五届会议后就推断出属性,我们称这些会议为检查站。
反应质量由第40、45、80、40、45、80场会议评估。
推论和评价产出从未添加到内存中,所有提示都在附录N中给出。

blocks.en: 2.2 Threat Model
blocks.zh: 2.2 威胁模式

blocks.en:
We are concerned with what the accumulated record reveals about the user.
Once a record exists, it can be exposed through the agent’s interactions with external services or accessed without authorization.
We therefore measure privacy loss as empirical leakage, the share of the user’s attribute values that can be correctly inferred from the full record ( Section 2.6 ).
We model the party that learns about the user as one that obtains the accumulated record and applies an LLM to it, with no auxiliary data about the user.
We instantiate this party with the support model itself, so leakage measures what the agent’s own record already exposes.
Appendix I repeats inference with stronger models from other developers.
The agent itself is not adversarial, since its instruction neither encourages nor discourages inferring or eliciting attributes (Appendix N.7 ).
The same 24 attributes 𝒜 \mathcal{A} ( Section 2.3 ) define each simulated user and are what the filters, the disclosure measurements, and inference all refer to.

一旦记录存在,可以通过代理商与外部服务的互动来曝光,或未经授权访问.
因此,我们把隐私损失计量为经验性渗漏,即可以从完整记录中正确推断出用户属性值的比例(第2.6节)。
我们把了解用户的一方模拟为获得累积记录的一方,并对其应用LLM,没有用户的辅助数据.
我们用支持模型本身对这个政党进行即时调查,
附 录 我重复其他开发商更强大的模型推论。

blocks.en: 2.3 Personal Attributes of Simulated Users
blocks.zh: 2.3 模拟用户的个人属性

blocks.en:
Each simulated user is defined by its values of the 24 attributes in 𝒜 \mathcal{A} , taken from one respondent of the 2024 American Community Survey Public Use Microdata Sample, which the U.S. Census Bureau releases with statistical disclosure limitations (Appendix A.1 ).
The first eight, adapted from Staab et al. (2024) , are age, sex, location, place of birth, income, education, occupation, and marital status, the last replacing their relationship status.
Sex is recorded as binary in the survey and is not a measure of gender identity.
The 16 attributes we add are employment status, citizenship, seven household attributes (own children, size, type, income, tenure, housing type, and vehicles), five attributes close to sensitive categories (race, Hispanic origin, disability, health insurance coverage, and military service), school enrollment, and internet access.
Such categories can contribute to re-identification when combined with auxiliary data ( Sweeney, 2002 ; Golle, 2006 ) .
Each attribute is categorical, with 2 to over 200 candidate values (Appendix A ), so absolute accuracy is not comparable across attributes, and we interpret results through comparisons between conditions.

此类类别与辅助数据相结合,有助于重新识别(Sweeney,2002年;Golle,2006年)。
每个属性都是绝对的,2至200多个候选值(Appendix A ),因此绝对准确性不在不同属性之间进行比较,我们通过条件比较来解释结果.

blocks.en: 2.4 User Simulation
blocks.zh: 2.4 用户模拟

blocks.en:
Profiles are drawn in proportion to the survey’s person weights and then selected so that rare values are covered (Appendix B ).
The user agent receives its own attributes, those of co-resident household members, and the user summary, a summary of its own earlier statements (Appendix N.3 , Appendix N.6 ).
Before any dialogue, an LLM writes one request per session for each profile, and the same request sequence is used in all conditions, so that conditions differ only in how each conversation unfolds.
Requests that would change a fixed attribute value, such as a move, are regenerated (Appendix N.1 , Appendix N.2 ).
Under the direct filter, the user agent is also instructed not to state or confirm any attribute value, and under the strict filter, also to leave out any detail that would narrow one down (Appendix N.4 ).
A turn is one user message together with the support agent’s response.

blocks.zh: 2.5 内存和用户回合过滤

blocks.en:
Filtering uses two LLM judges that classify a user turn against 𝒜 \mathcal{A} (Appendix N.9 , Appendix N.10 ).
For each attribute, the direct judge decides whether the turn states or confirms the user’s value.
The inferable judge, which also receives the ground-truth profile, decides whether the turn together with the preceding dialogue narrows the value down, that is, makes some values substantially more likely than others.
We say that a turn discloses an attribute at the value level if the direct judge flags it, which includes statements coarser than the attribute’s categories, and as a cue if only the inferable judge does.
The same judges are applied after the fact to measure disclosure, whereas empirical leakage comes only from attribute inference.

过滤使用两个LLM判断器,将一个用户转弯对 A\ mathcal{A}(附录N.9,附录N.10)进行分类.
对于每个属性,由直接法官决定转弯是表示还是确认用户的价值.
也收到地面真相简介的可推论法官决定与前一次对话合并是否缩小了价值,即使一些价值大大高于其他价值。
我们说,如果直接法官在价值级别上标出一个属性,它包括比属性类别紧凑的言论,如果只有可推论的法官这样做,则作为提示。
在衡量披露情况之后,适用同样的法官,而经验性渗漏仅来自属性推论。

blocks.en:
Under either filter, the judges check each user turn as a candidate before the support agent sees it.
The direct filter rejects it if it discloses any attribute at the value level, and the strict filter if it discloses any attribute at all.
A rejected candidate is discarded without a trace, and a new one is sampled without adding it to the dialogue context (Appendix N.5 ).
Each filter thus combines the instruction of Section 2.4 with rejection.
Because they reject whole turns and the strict filter uses the ground-truth profile, both are stricter than deployable filters.
We use them to test whether even such filtering can lower leakage without giving up the quality gains of memory.

blocks.en: 2.6 Measuring Leakage and Response Quality
blocks.zh: 2.6 测量泄漏和反应质量

blocks.en:
At each checkpoint s ∈ ℰ = { 5 , 10 , … , 80 } s\in\mathcal{E}=\{5,10,\ldots,80\} , the support model receives the full record of its run and infers all 24 attributes at once (Appendix N.11 ).
The answer “undetermined” is allowed and scored as incorrect, so Table 9 also reports how often it is chosen.

blocks.en: 3.2 Memory Raises Both Leakage and Quality
blocks.zh: 3.2 记忆既提高泄漏质量,也提高质量

blocks.en:
Besides comparing the six conditions, we separate consulting memory from elapsed sessions by branching.
We continue each unfiltered memory run from branch points b ∈ { 10 , 20 , … , 70 } b\in\{10,20,\ldots,70\} for ten sessions in two arms that do or do not consult memory, from the same history and with the same requests, and count the attributes predicted correctly for the first time after b b (Appendix G ).

我们继续从分支点b { { 10, 20,..., 70} b\ in\ 10, 20,\ ildots, 70} 在两个臂中进行十个会话, 从同一历史和相同的请求中, 并算出在b b(附录 G )之后第一次正确的预测属性 。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Memory raises empirical leakage, and filtering lowers it in both settings. Dashed lines show the majority-category reference.
blocks.zh: 图 2:内存提高经验性渗漏,过滤在两种情况下都会降低. 虚线显示多数类参考.

blocks.en:
Without filtering, memory yields higher leakage than no memory by the later checkpoints in every model, and the gap generally grows with sessions ( Figure 2 ).
The size of the gap thus depends on how long memory is used, and our 80 sessions are short compared with long-term use of a deployed assistant.
At the earliest checkpoints, while the record is still short, memory can yield slightly lower leakage.
Since both settings infer from their full records and memory sessions are shorter ( Table 8 ), the difference comes from what users say rather than how much.
Filtering lowers leakage in both settings, and memory keeps an advantage under the direct filter and a smaller one under the strict filter.
blocks.zh:
在不过滤的情况下,每个模型的内存的渗漏率高于后来的检查点的渗漏率,而且差距一般随着会话而增加(图2)。
因此,差距的大小取决于使用记忆的时间长短,与长期使用已部署的助理相比,我们80个会话很短。
在最早的检查站,虽然记录仍然很短,但记忆可以产生略低的渗漏.
由于两种设置都从他们的完整记录和内存会话中推断出时间较短(表8),不同之处来自用户所说的而不是多少.
过滤会降低两种设置的渗漏,内存在直接过滤器下保持优势,在严格过滤器下保持较小优势.

blocks.en:
From a common history, the arm that keeps consulting memory infers more previously uninferred attributes at every branch point, up to more than twice as many as the no-memory arm, and its advantage levels off as fewer attributes remain to infer ( Table 7 ).
In a pilot with eight human participants whose agent alternated between memory-on and memory-off blocks, every participant had more attributes first inferred with memory on, although they were instructed not to state any (Appendix J ).
blocks.zh:
从一个共同的历史来看,不断咨询记忆的手臂推断出每个分支点更多的以前未受感染的属性,最多为无记忆臂的两倍以上,其优势程度随着属性的减少而降低,以推断(表7).
在一个有8名人类参与者的飞行员中,他们的代理人在记忆上和记忆外的区块之间交替出现,每位参与者首先在记忆上推断出更多的属性,尽管他们被指示不要说明任何属性(附录J.

blocks.en:
Most of memory’s gain is in precision on answered attributes rather than in fewer abstentions ( Table 9 ).
Stronger inference models recover more from the same records with the gap intact, so inferring with the support model understates what the record reveals (Appendix I ).
The gap also appears when memory is updated in place or retrieved by relevance, and is smallest with retrieval, which consults the least of the history during dialogue (Appendix F ).
blocks.zh:
记忆的大部分收益是准确的回答属性,而不是更少的弃权(表9).
更强的推论模型在空白完好无损的情况下从相同的记录中恢复得更多,因此与支持模型推论低估了记录揭示的内容(附录一.

blocks.en:
Memory raises helpfulness and, more strongly, coherence in every model ( Figure 3 ).
With memory, both scores fall as filtering becomes stricter.
The direct filter stays above unfiltered no memory, whereas the strict filter lands close to it, partly because less earlier information is left to carry forward.
Filtering thus lowers leakage and quality together, and memory raises both with Mistral Small 4 in all user-side roles as well (Appendix E ).
blocks.zh:
记忆提高了每个模型的有用性,更有力地提高了一致性(图3)。
有了记忆,随着过滤变得更加严格,两个分数都下降了.
直接过滤器在未过滤器上方没有内存,而严格的过滤器在靠近它的地方,部分原因是没有更早的信息可以继续。
因此过滤可以降低泄漏和质量,同时在用户方的所有角色中,内存与Mistral Small 4同时提高(附录E )。

blocks.en: 3.3 How the Loop Works
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 循环是如何运作的

blocks.en:
To find what in the conversations produces the gap, we follow the loop of Figure 1 , which we first make precise.
For an attribute, a mention is part of a support-agent response that states a value for the user (a reference), asks the user to confirm one (a confirmation question), or tailors its content in a way appropriate only for some values (a presupposition).
An open question about the attribute is not a mention.
The loop consists of three links .
A value or cue in memory leads to a mention in a later session (memory → \to response).
The user reacts by affirming the value, correcting it, declining to discuss it, or leaving it uncorrected (response → \to user).
The summary of that session records the reaction (user → \to memory).
Each link can be explicit, as when a value is stated or affirmed, or implicit, as when only a cue is recorded, a value is presupposed, or a mention is left uncorrected.
blocks.zh:
为了在对话中找到什么产生差距,我们遵循图1的循环,我们首先精确地说明。
对于一个属性,一个提及是支持代理响应的一部分,该响应为用户表示一个值(一个引用),要求用户确认一个(一个确认问题),或者以仅适合一些值的方式调整其内容(一个预设).
关于属性的未解问题不提.
循环包括三个链接。
内存中的值或提示导致在以后的会话中提及(记忆 ~\ to response).
用户的反应是确认值,纠正值,拒绝讨论值,或者未改正值(答复 ~\\给用户).
该次会议的摘要记录了反应(用户 \\ to memory)。
每个链接都可以是明确的,比如当一个值被声明或确认,或者隐含,比如当只记录一个提示,一个值被预先设定,或者一个提法未被修正.

blocks.en:
An annotator model , Mistral Small 4, which generates none of the analyzed text, labels each mention and where its value came from, the user’s reaction, whether a disclosure gives the value or only a cue, and what each summary records (Appendix K ).
Session 1, in which memory is still empty, serves as a placebo.
We also replay single memory-conditioned responses after regenerating them without memory or after an editing model , also Mistral Small 4, removes their mentions, and sample the next user turn for each version (Appendix K.4 ).
Human annotators confirm both the labels and the edits (Appendix D.4 ).
blocks.zh:
一个注释器模型Mistral Small 4, 它不产生任何分析过的文本, 标注每个文本及其价值来自何方, 用户的反应,
第1会场内记忆仍为空,充当安慰剂.
我们还在没有内存或经过编辑模型的重现后重放单个内存条件化的回复,同样是Mistral Small 4,去掉他们的提及,并抽取每个版本的下一个用户转折(Appendix K.4 ).
人类注释者既确认标签,也确认编辑(附录D.4 ).

blocks.en: Table 1: Memory changes disclosure only after the agent responds, through values carried forward from earlier sessions. Unfiltered runs, with the full breakdown in Table 15 .
blocks.zh: 表1:内存仅在代理回复后,通过以往会话中结转的值改变披露. 未过滤运行,表15为全部细目。

blocks.en: In session 1 and in the opening turn of later sessions, the two settings disclose at the same rate, and the difference appears only in later turns ( Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 在会话1和以后的会话的开幕转折中,两种设置以同样的速度披露,差异只出现在以后的转折中(表1 )。

blocks.en:
More than a third of memory-conditioned responses carry forward a value from an earlier session, most of them correct.
Responses without memory instead ask more open questions and more often rest on assumptions with no basis in anything the agent could see.
blocks.zh:
超过三分之一的有内存条件的回复从早先的会话中传承了价值,其中大部分是正确的.
相反,没有记忆的答复提出了更多的开放问题,更经常地依赖于没有任何依据的假设,而代理人所能看到的一切。

blocks.en:
The additional disclosures are mostly affirmations of a presupposed value and almost entirely at the value level, and over whole runs more user turns state or narrow down an attribute ( Table 10 ).
Memory thus mainly raises attributes already hinted at as a range or a cue to the value level, consistent with the branching results.
Replaying single responses points the same way.
Removing only the mentions from a memory-conditioned response removes most of its effect on the next user turn, while keeping most of the coherence advantage and leaving helpfulness unchanged ( Table 16 , Appendix K.4 ).
blocks.zh:
额外披露大多是预先假定的价值的确认,而且几乎完全在价值水平上,总体来说,更多的用户变态或缩小属性(表10)。
因此内存主要提升已作为数值级别范围或提示提示的属性,与分支结果一致.
重播单曲回应同样指向.
仅删除内存条件下的响应中的引用,就消除了它对下一个用户转弯的大部分影响,同时保持大部分一致性优势,并保持有用性不变(表16,附录K.4).

blocks.en:
Every link occurs in both explicit and implicit forms ( Table 17 ).
Summaries record cues as well as values, including values introduced by the agent and left uncorrected, even though the summarizer is instructed to record only what the user said (Appendix N.8 ).
Most reactions leave a proposed value uncorrected.
Under the direct filter, the loop mostly closes without any explicit user statement, typically as a recorded cue that returns, most often as a presupposition, and is left uncorrected ( Table 17 , Table 18 ).
blocks.zh:
每个环节都以明示和默示两种形式出现(表17)。
摘要记录提示和值,包括代理商引入的数值,未更正,即使摘要被指示只记录用户所说的话(附录N.8 ).
大多数反应都留下了拟议价值没有修正.
在直接过滤器下,循环大多关闭,没有任何明确的用户语句,通常作为记录的提示返回,最常见的是作为预设,而不更正(表17,表18)。

blocks.en:
Most carried-forward values are correct, so affirming them amounts to answering truthfully, and without filtering users correct incorrect ones in a substantial share of cases ( Table 21 ).
Leaving a presupposition that is beside the point uncorrected is also how listeners ordinarily treat presuppositions ( Lewis, 1979 ; Stalnaker, 2002 ) .
With a user agent from a different developer, the loop closes through the same forms in similar proportions ( Table 18 ), and participants of the human pilot, asked not to state their attributes, also mostly left mentions uncorrected and affirmed them more often than the filtered simulated users (Appendix J ).
blocks.zh:
大多数结转的数值是正确的,因此确认这些数值等于是真实的回答,在相当大比例的案件中,没有过滤用户纠正错误(表21)。
留下一个未改正的假设,也是听众通常如何对待假设(Lewis,1979年;Stalnaker,2002年)。
由于来自不同开发者的用户代理,循环以相似的比例通过相同的形式关闭(表18),人类飞行员的参与者要求不要说明其属性,也大多左侧提及未更正,并比被过滤的模拟用户(Appendix J)更频繁地确认.

blocks.en: 3.4 The Loop Reinforces Itself and Entrenches Errors
blocks.zh: 3.4 循环增强自身和创业错误

blocks.en:
To test whether each pass of the loop makes the next more likely, we continue the unfiltered and direct-filter memory runs from b = 40 b=40 for ten sessions while the editing model edits every response.
For one random group of attributes it removes all mentions (all removed), for another only references and confirmation questions (explicit removed), and a third group is left untouched.
We count the first turn in the run that discloses each attribute at the value level, or, under the direct filter, which removes such turns, the first that gives a cue to it.
If a mention only prompted the next user turn, removing it would cost exactly that turn’s disclosures, which we measure by replay.
A larger reduction means that the mention also made later mentions, and thus later disclosures, more likely.
We call the loop self-reinforcing for a group if the reduction in its first disclosures, relative to the untouched group, exceeds this single-turn prediction (Appendix L ).
blocks.zh:
为了测试每个循环的通过是否使下一个更可能,我们继续未过滤和直接过滤的内存从b=40b=40运行到10个会话,而编辑模型则编辑每个响应.
对于一个随机的属性组,它去掉所有提及(全部去掉),对于另一个只去掉提及和确认问题(显性去掉),第三个组则未被触及.
我们计算运行中的第一个回合,在值级上披露每个属性,或者,在直接过滤器下消除这种转折,第一个给它一个提示。
如果提及只是促使下个用户转弯,删除它会花掉我们通过重播衡量的该转弯的披露。
更大幅度的减少意味着后来也提到,因而以后更可能披露。
相对于未触及的组而言,如果其首次披露的减少量超过了这个单转预测(Appendix L ),则我们称之为一个组的循环自我强化.

blocks.en: Table 2: Removing the agent’s mentions reduces later disclosure beyond what single-turn effects predict. Counts are per 1,000 attributes over sessions 41 to 50.
blocks.zh: 表2:删除代理商的提及会减少以后的披露,超出单回合效应的预测. 计数在41至50会话中为每1000个属性.

blocks.en:
Removing the agent’s mentions of an attribute lowers its later disclosure by about twice what single-turn effects predict ( Table 2 ).
This holds with and without filtering, and fewer of these attributes are newly inferred.
Removing only references and confirmation questions also exceeds its prediction, even under the direct filter, where no link of the loop is then explicit, and the excess grows over the ten sessions ( Table 19 ).
blocks.zh:
移除代理商对属性的提及,使其后来的披露减少约两倍于单回合效应预测(表2).
不论有无过滤,这些属性中新推断的较少。
仅删除引用和确认问题也超过了其预测,甚至在直接过滤下也是如此,在直接过滤下,循环没有明显的链接,超过部分在十个会话中增加(表19 )。

blocks.en:
An incorrect value carried forward from an earlier session is often left uncorrected, recorded, and predicted again at the next checkpoint ( Table 21 ).
Under the direct filter, where correcting it would state the attribute, users rarely correct it.
blocks.zh:
先前届会结转的不正确数值往往没有更正、记录,并在下一个检查站再次预测(表21)。
在直接过滤器下,如果更正它会说明属性,用户很少更正它.

blocks.en:
Under the direct filter, users decline to discuss a mentioned attribute more often when its true value is in a set fixed before labeling, such as lacking health insurance or citizenship ( Table 22 ).
After a refusal, the next prediction leans toward these values, becoming correct more often for users who hold them and less often for those who do not ( Table 22 ).
A refused incorrect value is also recorded and predicted again about as often as one left uncorrected ( Table 21 ).
A refusal thus tends either to reveal a sensitive value or to attribute one to users who do not hold it.
blocks.zh:
在直接过滤器下,用户拒绝更经常地讨论上述属性,如果其真实值是在标签前固定的一组,例如缺乏健康保险或公民身份(表22)。
在遭到拒绝后,下一个预测倾向于这些数值,对持有这些数值的用户来说更经常正确,而对不持有这些数值的用户来说更经常正确(表22)。
拒绝的不正确数值也记录下来并再次预测,与未更正的数值一样频繁(表21)。
因此,拒绝往往要么揭示敏感值,要么将敏感值归属于不持有该值的用户。

blocks.en: 3.5 Where to Intervene
blocks.zh: 3.5 国家 向何处干涉

blocks.en:
We compare mitigations that intervene at three points in the loop.
The adversarial anonymization of Staab et al. (2025) , with 𝒜 \mathcal{A} as targets, is applied either to each user turn (user-side anonymization) or to each summary before it is stored (write-time anonymization).
Alternatively, the support agent’s instruction is extended so that it does not state, presuppose, or ask to confirm the user’s attributes unless the user raises them (response-side instruction).
Each is added to the unfiltered memory setting for the two open-weight support models on all profiles, and we also record the share of responses with mentions (Appendix M ).
The two filters serve as idealized bounds, whereas the instruction is a change a provider can deploy directly.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了在三点上进行干预的缓解措施。
Staaab等人(2025年)的对抗性无名化,以 A\ mathcal{A}作为目标,要么应用到每个用户转弯(用户侧无名化),要么在存储前应用到每个摘要(write-time无名化).
或者,支持代理的指令被扩展,这样它就不会说明、预先假定或要求确认用户的属性,除非用户提出这些属性(答复方指令)。
每个都添加到所有配置图上两个开放量级支持模型的未过滤内存设置中,我们也记录了有提及(Appendix M )的回复份额.
这两个过滤器是理想化的界限,而指令是提供者可以直接部署的改变。

blocks.en: Table 3: Only the response-side instruction lowers leakage without giving up most of the quality gains. Averages over the two open-weight support models, with daggers relative to memory.
blocks.zh: 表3:只有响应方指令在不放弃大部分质量收益的情况下降低渗漏。 平均超过两个开放量级支持模型,与内存相对有匕首.

blocks.en:
Only the response-side instruction lowers leakage without giving up most of the quality gains ( Table 3 ).
It cuts mentions below even the no-memory level and brings leakage to about the no-memory level, as the idealized direct filter does.
Helpfulness is unchanged, and most of the coherence gain remains.
The other conditions lower leakage only by giving up quality.
User-side anonymization lowers leakage almost as much as the strict filter and, like it, gives up nearly all of the gain in coherence.
Write-time anonymization keeps most of the gain in helpfulness but loses most of the gain in coherence, since what is removed from the record can no longer be carried forward.
This ordering holds for both support models ( Table 24 ), and the instruction works similarly with another user model, other memory formats (Appendix F ), and stronger inference models (Appendix I ).

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en:
LLMs infer personal attributes from text ( Staab et al., 2024 ; Yukhymenko et al., 2024 ) , and evaluations measure what given histories and streams reveal ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Cögendez et al., 2026 ) .
Persistent memory is common in deployed assistants, and research systems such as MemoryBank ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) carry session-level summaries forward, as does later work on user profiles ( Prottasha et al., 2025 ) .
These studies analyze given records, whereas we intervene on dialogue-time memory access.
That disclosure elicits disclosure was documented long before LLMs, between people ( Jourard, 1971 ; Collins and Miller, 1994 ; Altman and Taylor, 1973 ) and with computers and chatbots ( Moon, 2000 ; Lee et al., 2020 ) , alongside the tension between personalization and privacy ( Awad and Krishnan, 2006 ) .
In that work, disclosure is elicited by the system’s own disclosure or requests, whereas here it arises as the agent carries the user’s earlier disclosures and its own guesses forward, often by presupposing them.
blocks.zh:
LLMs从文本中推断出个人属性(Staab等人,2024年;Yukhymenko等人,2024年),以及评价衡量给定的历史和流的启示(Jiang等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年;Cögendez等人,2026年).
持续的内存在部署的助手中很常见,记忆银行(Zhong等人,2024年)等研究系统将会话级摘要带往前,后来的用户简介工作也是如此(Protasha等人,2025年).
这些研究分析了给定的记录,而我们对对话时间的内存访问进行干预。
这一披露在LLMs之前很久就已经记录在案,在人与人之间(Jourard,1971年;Collins和Miller,1994年;Altman和Taylor,1973年)以及在计算机和聊天台上(Moon,2000年;Lee等人,2020年),以及个人化与隐私之间的紧张关系(Awad和Krishnan,2006年)。
在这项工作中,披露是由系统本身的披露或要求所引起,而在此情况下,代理人往往通过预先假定而将用户先前的披露和自己的猜测推向前进。

blocks.en:
Privacy risks of language models were first studied mainly for training data, through membership inference and extraction ( Shokri et al., 2017 ; Carlini et al., 2021 ; Kaneko et al., 2025 ) .
Other work asks whether agents handle available personal information appropriately ( Mireshghallah et al., 2024 ; Mireshghallah et al., 2026 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) or attacks memory by extraction ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Lyu et al., 2026 ) , exfiltration ( Zhang and Pei, 2026 ) , or injection ( Dong et al., 2025 ) (see Lin et al. (2026) for a survey), and the information an adversary can extract per query has been bounded theoretically ( Kaneko and Baldwin, 2025 ) .
These studies take the information as given, whereas we study how it comes to be there.
On the defensive side, Staab et al. (2025) anonymize text by rewriting what makes an attribute inferable, and we apply their approach to user turns and to memory and compare it with filtering and with changing the agent’s responses.

语言模型的隐私风险首先通过会员推论和提取来研究培训数据(Shokri等人,2017年;Carlini等人,2021年;Kaneko等人,2025年)。
其他工作还询问,特工人员是妥善处理现有个人资料(Mireshghallah等人,2024年;Mireshghallah等人,2026年;Shao等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025年b),还是通过提取(Wang等人,2025年a;Lyu等人,2026年),过滤(张和培,2026年),还是注射(Dong等人,2025年)(调查见Lin等人,(2026年)),以及敌对者每次查询可以提取的资料在理论上是受约束的(Kaneko和Baldwin,2025年))。
这些研究将这些信息作为参考,而我们则研究如何做到这一点。
在防守方面,Staab等人(2025年)通过重写属性可推论的内容来对文本进行匿名化,我们将他们的方法应用于用户转动和内存,并与过滤和改变代理人的反应进行比较.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Consulting memory during dialogue changes what users say, and with it what their record reveals.
Across four support models, memory raised leakage together with response quality, through a loop in which the agent carries values forward and users affirm them or let them pass.
The loop reinforces itself, entrenches incorrect values, and is not escaped by refusing, so weakening it falls to the provider.
The most effective place to do so is where the loop starts, at the agent’s response.
A human pilot points in the same direction, although whether its rates hold across many users remains to be measured.
blocks.zh:
在对话期间咨询记忆会改变用户的言论,以及他们的记录所揭示的内容。
在整个四个支持模型中,内存随着反应质量而增加渗漏,通过一个循环,即代理人传递值,用户确认值或让值通过值。
循环会增强自身,巩固不正确的价值,并且不会因拒绝而逃脱,因此削弱它属于提供者。
这样做的最有效的地方是循环的起点,即代理商的反应。
一个人类试验点也朝同一方向发展,尽管其比率在许多用户中是否维持,仍有待衡量。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
The main experiment uses no data about real individuals, since profiles come from the disclosure-limited ACS PUMS and all dialogues are generated by LLM agents.
The eight annotators of Appendix D were paid $25 per hour, informed of the purpose of the task and of how their annotations would be used, and consented before beginning.
In the main annotation tasks, they saw only generated dialogues and profiles built from Census records.
The eight participants of the human pilot (Appendix J ), none of whom served as annotators, were paid $25 per hour and consented to take part, including to the analysis of their conversation logs by the research team.
Three of the annotators read these logs, two to label mentions and reactions and one to adjudicate disagreements, and no participant-level attribute values or conversation content are reported.
Both the annotation study and the pilot were reviewed and approved by our institution.
We do not propose an attack.
The support agent receives a neutral instruction and default settings, and inference uses only memory that such an agent already holds.
Our aim is to inform the design of memory and of how agents draw on it in their responses.

blocks.en:
The person weight ( PWGTP ) is the survey weight giving how many people each record represents.
It is unrelated to the attribute weights of Appendix A.3 , and drawing with it makes the pool representative of the population before the greedy step covers rare values.
We join the person and household files of the 2024 ACS 1-year PUMS on SERIALNO and keep adult household residents with a valid occupation code ( OCCP ).
Incomes are expressed in 2024 dollars using the file’s inflation adjustment factor and then banded (Appendix A.2 ).
We use M = 100,000 M=100{,}000 , N = 300 N=300 , and K = 300 K=300 .
A further 30 development profiles, disjoint from these, were used to fix the prompts and the age and income band widths, and no reported result uses them.
Each session is limited to T T turns, with no minimum.
The user agent ends it with an end token when it considers the request resolved (Appendix N.3 ), and realized lengths are reported in Table 8 .
The support model must fit the full memory, and in the no-memory setting the full record given at inference time, in its context, and memory never had to be truncated.
blocks.zh:
人体重(PWGTP)是给出每张记录代表多少人的调查加权.
它与附录A.3的属性权重无关,在贪婪的台阶覆盖稀有价值之前,用它绘制的池子就代表了人口.
我们加入2024年ACS 1年PUMS关于SERIALNO的个人和家庭档案,并保留一个有效的职业代码(OCCP)的成年住户。
收入以2024美元为单位,使用文件的通货膨胀调整系数,然后加段(附录A.2.)。

每场会话都限于T T转弯,没有最小的.
用户代理在其认为请求已解决(附录N.3)时,以一个结束符号结尾,实现的长度在表8中报告.
支持模式必须符合完整的内存,在无记忆设定在推论时间给出的全部记录,在其上下文中,内存永远不会被截断.

blocks.en: Appendix C Uncertainty
blocks.zh: 附录C

blocks.en:
All conditions share the same profiles and request sequences, so comparisons are paired by profile.
Intervals are 95% percentile bootstrap intervals from 1,000 resamples of the N N profiles.
Bands in Figure 2 and Figure 4 and error bars in Figure 3 are per-condition intervals, not intervals for the paired differences.
In tables, a dagger ( † ) marks a per-profile difference between conditions whose interval excludes zero or, in the loop-breaking tables, a ratio of observed to predicted reductions whose interval excludes one.
Intervals are computed per support model and, where a table averages over models, averaged over models within each resample.
blocks.zh:
所有条件都共享相同的剖面图和请求序列,因此比较用剖面图对齐.
N型剖面图的1 000个复标的间隔为95%。
图2和图4中的波段和图3中的误差栏是每个条件的间隔,而不是配对差异的间隔.
在表格中,匕首( )表示在间隔排除为零的条件之间,或者在打破循环的表格中,在间隔排除为零的条件与预测的减少比例之间,有明显的差异。
每个支持模型都计算出中间值,如果一个表格平均值大于模型,则在每个重现模型中均值。

blocks.en: Appendix D Human Validation of the LLM Components
blocks.zh: 附录D 对LLM部分的人类验证

blocks.en: We compare five LLM components with human annotation, namely the direct judge (Appendix N.9 ), the inferable judge (Appendix N.10 ), the evaluator (Appendix N.12 ), the annotator model (Appendix N.13 , Appendix N.14 , Appendix N.15 ), and the editing model (Appendix N.16 ).
blocks.zh: 我们比较了五个LLM成分与人类注释,即直接裁判(附录N.9),推论裁判(附录N.10),评审(附录N.12),注释模型(附录N.13),附录N.14,附录N.15),以及编辑模型(附录N.16).

blocks.en: D.1 Annotators
blocks.zh: D.1 注释员

blocks.en:
Eight research assistants, none of whom was involved in designing the prompts or analyzing the results, served as annotators.
All hold at least a bachelor’s degree and are fluent in English, and they were paid $25 per hour.
Consent and approval are described in the Ethics Statement.
They were given the definitions in the corresponding prompts verbatim, with no separate codebook.
Since the prompts were fixed on the development profiles (Appendix B ), the definitions were fixed before any item from the main run was opened.
blocks.zh:
8名研究助理,其中无一人参与设计提示或分析结果,担任注释员。
所有学生至少拥有学士学位,而且英语流利,每小时领取25美元。
同意和批准情况见道德操守说明。
它们在相应的提示式逐字记录中得到了定义,没有单独的编码本。
由于这些提示固定在开发配置图上(Appendix B ),所以定义在主运行中的任何项目打开之前都是固定的.

blocks.en:
Each item was annotated independently by two annotators, with pairs rotated across batches.
Where a gold label is needed, disagreements were adjudicated by a third annotator who had not seen the item.
For the judges and the annotator model, annotators saw the ground-truth profile of the user, and for the quality ratings they did not.
Annotators never saw the condition an item came from or the output of the LLM being validated.
Because pairs rotate, agreement on the quality ratings is measured with ordinal Krippendorff’s α \alpha .
blocks.zh:
每个项目都由两个注释员独立注释,对子按批次旋转.
在需要金色标签的地方,第三个没有看到该物品的注释员裁定了分歧。
对于法官和注释员模型,注释员看到了用户的地面真实状况,而对于他们没有获得的质量评级。
注释者从未看到一个物品来自的条件或LLM的输出被验证.
由于对子旋转,对质量评分的一致用正统Krippendorff的α\α来衡量.

blocks.en: D.2 Judges
blocks.zh: D.2 法官

blocks.en:
For each judge, we sample 200 items from the main run, stratified by the judge’s decision into 100 positive and 100 negative items.
Each item is a candidate user turn, including candidates rejected before delivery, and one target attribute.
Annotators judge that attribute with the corresponding definition, given the same current-session dialogue that the judge receives.
The stratified sample checks both positive and negative decisions and does not estimate how often turns reveal attributes.
blocks.zh:
对每位法官来说,我们抽样抽查了200件主要案件,根据法官的决定分为100件正面案件和100件负面案件。
每个项目都是候选用户回合,包括交付前被拒绝的候选人,以及一个目标属性.
注释者根据相应的定义来判断属性,因为法官接受的时段对话相同.
分层抽样检查了正反两方面的决定,没有估计如何频繁地显示属性。

blocks.en:
The direct judge agrees with the adjudicated label on 184 of 200 items (92%, F1 = = 0.921), with 7 false positives and 9 false negatives.
The inferable judge agrees on 176 of 200 (88%, F1 = = 0.880), with 12 false positives and 12 false negatives.
These figures describe the stratified sample, not all generated turns.
Annotators, like the inferable judge, saw the ground-truth profile.
The direct judge does not see it, so its human labels were made with more information than the judge had.
blocks.zh:
直接法官同意对200项中的184项(92%,F1 = = 0.921)的裁决标签,其中7项为假阳性,9项为假阴性.
推论法官同意200人中的176人(88%,F1 = = = 0.880),12人为假阳性,12人为假阴性.
这些数字描述了分层抽样,而不是所有产生的转弯。
注释者与可推论的法官一样,看到了地面真相简介.
直接法官没有看到它,所以它的人类标签是用比法官更多的信息制作的.

blocks.en: D.3 Evaluator
blocks.zh: D.3 评价员

blocks.en:
Annotators rate 300 responses from sessions 40 , 45 , … , 80 40,45,\ldots,80 on the two scales of Appendix N.12 , using only the current session for helpfulness and also the user summary for coherence.
Human agreement (ordinal Krippendorff’s α \alpha ) is 0.69 for helpfulness and 0.66 for coherence, and the evaluator’s Spearman correlation with the mean human rating is 0.67 and 0.64.
blocks.zh:
注释者在附录N.12的两个尺度上对第40、45、......、80、40、45、\ldots、80届会议的300份答复进行评分,只利用本届会议的帮助和用户摘要来进行一致性。
人类协议(Nordinal Krippendorff的α α α α)为0.69,一致性为0.66,评估者Spearman与人类平均评级的关联为0.67和0.64.

blocks.en: D.4 Annotator Model and Edits
blocks.zh: D.4 注释模型和编辑

blocks.en:
Two annotators labeled samples of each kind of annotation of Appendix K , with adjudication as above.
For the response and disclosure labels, they labeled 120 support-agent responses and 100 flagged disclosures.
For the loop labels, they labeled 400 summary–attribute pairs and 300 reactions, and they also judged for 150 sampled cycles whether all links occur as matched.
Because refusals are rare in a random sample, a further 200 reactions labeled as refusals by the annotator model were labeled by the same annotators.
Because the runs with Claude Sonnet 5 and with Mistral Small 4 as the user agent are labeled by different annotator models (Appendix K ), 200 reactions sampled equally from both are labeled by both models.
For the editing model, annotators judged for 60 accepted edits whether all targeted mentions were removed without changing other content. Table 5 gives the results.
Unless a row states otherwise, agreement is between the annotator model and the adjudicated human labels.
blocks.zh:
附录K的每种注释的两种标注样本,如上。
对于答复和披露标签,它们标注了120个支持代理答复和100个标注的披露。
对于环形标签,它们标注了400个汇总-属性配对和300个反应,它们还针对150个抽样周期判断所有链接是否都以匹配的方式出现.
由于拒绝在随机抽样中是罕见的,另外200个被标记为注释者模型拒绝的反应也被同样的注释者贴上标签.
由于与克劳德·索内5和以Mistral Small 4为用户代理的运行被不同的注释模型(Appendix K )标注,从两个模型中平等取样的200个反应被两个模型标注.
对于编辑模式,注释者判断60个被接受的编辑是否删除所有目标提及而不改变其他内容. 表5列出了结果。
除非一行人另有说明,否则在注释模型和裁定的人类标签之间达成协议。

blocks.en: Table 5: Human validation of the annotator model and the editing model.
blocks.zh: 表5:注释器模型和编辑模型的人类验证.

blocks.en: Appendix E Alternative User-Side Model
blocks.zh: 附录E 替代用户系统模型

blocks.en:
To check that the results of Section 3 are not specific to Claude Sonnet 5, we repeat the main experiment with Mistral Small 4 ( mistralai/Mistral-Small-4-119B-2603 ) in every role that Claude Sonnet 5 plays in Section 3.1 .
It generates and checks the requests, plays the user agent, generates the user summaries, serves as the direct and inferable judges, and rates response quality.
The support models are Qwen3.8-27B and V4-Flash, and the support-agent summary is still generated by the support model of each run.
The profiles, prompts, attribute set, S S , and T T are those of Section 3 , and all six conditions are run for each support model.
Because the requests are regenerated by Mistral Small 4, the request sequences differ from those of the main experiment but are shared across the conditions of this setting.
Mistral Small 4 comes from a different developer than both support models, so no response is rated by the model that produced it.
Rejected candidates are handled as in Appendix N.5 , and every turn obtained a passing candidate within at most seven resamplings.
The human validation of Appendix D applies to Claude Sonnet 5, and the judges and the evaluator in this setting are not validated against human annotation.
blocks.zh:
为了确认第3节的结果不是Claude Sonnet 5的特异性,我们重复了对Mistral Small 4(Mistralai/Mistral-Small-4-119B-2603)在第3.1节的每一角色中的主要实验.
它生成和检查请求,扮演用户代理,生成用户摘要,担任直接和可推论的法官,评分回复质量.
支持模式为Qune3.8-27B和V4-Flash,支持代理汇总仍由每个运行的支持模式生成.
剖面图、提示、属性集、SS和TT是第3节的剖面图、提示、属性集、SS和TT。
由于请求由Mistral Small 4重新生成,因此请求序列与主实验序列不同,但在此设定条件下共享.
Mistral Small 4来自一个不同于两个支持模型的开发者,因此没有反应被生产该模型的模型评级.
被否决的候选人按附录N.5的规定处理,每次投票最多在7次复选中获得一名通过考试的候选人。
附录D的人类验证适用于Claude Sonnet 5,在此情况下的评委和评价者不经过人类注释验证.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Empirical leakage with Mistral Small 4 on the user side. Dashed lines show the majority-category reference.
blocks.zh: 图4:用户端与Mistral Small 4发生经验性泄漏. 虚线显示多数类参考.

blocks.en:
Figure 4 shows the same pattern as Figure 2 .
Without filtering, memory and no memory are close up to about session 30 and then separate, and memory ends higher in both models (append-only rows of Table 6 ).
With memory, final leakage falls from unfiltered to the direct filter to the strict filter in both models.
Memory stays above no memory under the direct filter, and under the strict filter the gap narrows to between 0.02 and 0.04.
blocks.zh:
图4显示的模式与图2相同。
不进行过滤,内存和没有内存会关闭到大约30个会话,然后分离,内存在两种模型(表6的仅附录行)中结束较高.
有了内存,最终的渗漏从未过滤到直接过滤到两个模型中的严格过滤.
内存停留在直接滤波器下无内存以上,在严格滤波器下,间隙缩小到0.02至0.04之间.

blocks.en: Without filtering, memory raises both helpfulness and coherence in both models, with the larger gap on coherence (append-only rows of Table 6 ).
blocks.zh: 在不过滤的情况下,内存在两种模型中都提高了帮助性和一致性,在一致性方面差距较大(表6的附录行)。

blocks.en: Appendix F Other Memory Formats
blocks.zh: 附录F 其他内存格式

blocks.en:
The main experiment appends a summary of each session to memory and gives the agent all summaries ( Section 2.5 ).
Deployed assistants also keep individual facts about the user that are updated in place, and retrieve past conversations by relevance.
We therefore repeat the main comparison and the response-side instruction with two further formats, each built on an existing implementation.
blocks.zh:
主要实验将每场会议的摘要附在内存中,并向代理人提供所有摘要(第2.5节)。
部署的助理人员还将更新的用户个人事实保留下来,并按相关性检索过去的对话。
因此,我们以另外两种形式重复主要比较和反应方指示,每种形式都以现有的执行为基础。

blocks.en:
The user side follows Appendix E , so Mistral Small 4 generates the requests, plays the user agent, generates the user summaries, and serves as the judges and the evaluator, and the request sequences of that setting are reused.
The support models are Qwen3.8-27B and V4-Flash with the generation settings of Section 3.1 , and the profiles, S S , and T T are those of the main experiment.
Mentions are measured as in Appendix M , with Claude Sonnet 5 as the annotator model so that no response is labeled by the model that played the user.
As in Appendix E , the judges and the evaluator in this setting are not validated against human annotation.
blocks.zh:
用户端遵循附录E,因此Mistral Small 4生成请求,扮演用户代理,生成用户摘要,并担任评委和评价员,该设置的请求序列被重用.
支持型号为Qwen3.8-27B和V4-Flash,具有第3.1节的生成设置,剖面,SS,TT是主实验的.
引用量如附录M所示,以克劳德·索内特5为注释器模型,这样任何响应都不会被播放用户的模型标注.
与附录E一样,在此情况下,法官和评价人员不经过人文注释验证。

blocks.en:
We use Mem0 ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) (version 2.0.2), in which an LLM extracts facts about the user from a conversation and decides for each whether to add it to memory, update or delete an existing memory, or leave memory unchanged.
The LLM is the support model of each run.
Embeddings use bge-m3 ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , and the vector store, the history store, and all prompts are the defaults of the released implementation, with graph memory disabled.
After each session, all of its messages, from both the user and the support agent, are passed to Mem0 in one call under an identifier for the profile.
In the memory setting, all stored memories are given to the support agent in the memory block of Appendix N.7 , so that, as in the main experiment, the agent sees during dialogue what inference later reads.
At each checkpoint, inference reads all memories stored at that point.
Memories deleted or overwritten by Mem0 are thus absent from later records, as they would be in deployment.
Unlike the summarizer of Appendix N.8 , the default extraction prompt does not instruct the model to leave out the assistant’s assumptions about the user, and we keep it unchanged.
blocks.zh:
我们使用Mem0(Chhikara等人,2025年)(2.0.2版),其中LLM从一次对话中提取用户的事实,并分别决定是添加到内存中,更新还是删除现有的内存,还是保留记忆不变.
LLM是每次运行的支持模式.
Embeddings使用bge-m3(Chen et al., 2024),以及矢量商店,历史商店,所有提示都是发布执行的默认,图内存被禁用.
每次会话结束后,其所有来自用户和支持代理的邮件都会在配置文件标识符下在一次呼叫中传递给Mem0.
在内存设置中,所有存储的内存都交给附录N.7的内存块中的辅助代理,这样一来,如同主实验一样,代理在对话中看到了后来的推论.
在每个检查站,推论读取所有存储在那个地点的记忆.
因此,Mem0删除或覆盖的记忆没有出现在以后的记录中,因为这些记忆将部署。
与附录N.8的总结不同的是,默认的提取提示不指示模型忽略助理对用户的假设,我们保持不变.

blocks.en:
Memory stores the session summaries of Appendix N.8 , one document per session, embedded with bge-m3.
At every user turn, the five summaries most similar to that turn by cosine similarity are retrieved with FAISS ( Douze et al., 2024 ) , ordered by session, and given to the support agent in the memory block.
The current session is not yet stored and cannot be retrieved.
At each checkpoint, inference reads all summaries, so the record is the same kind as in the main experiment, and the formats differ only in which summaries the agent sees during dialogue.
blocks.zh:
内存存储附录N.8的会话摘要,每会话一个文件,内嵌bge-m3.
在每个用户转弯时,最类似于该转弯的五份摘要都会与FAISS(Douze等人,2024年)一起检索,按会话排序,并交给内存块中的支持代理.
当前会话尚未存储,无法检索 。
在每个检查点,推论会读出所有摘要,因此记录与主实验中相同,格式只有代理在对话中看到的摘要不同.

blocks.en:
Each format is run under memory, no memory, and the response-side instruction of Appendix N.18 , all without filtering.
Without memory, the support agent sees nothing from earlier sessions, so the conversations do not depend on the format.
The append-only rows therefore reuse the memory and no-memory runs of Appendix E .
The retrieval-based no-memory row is identical to the append-only one, since both keep the same summaries, and the update-based no-memory record is built by passing the transcripts of the append-only no-memory runs to Mem0 in session order.
New runs are the memory and response-side conditions of the two new formats and the response-side condition of the append-only format.
blocks.zh:
每个格式在内存下运行,无内存,以及附录N.18的响应侧指示,全部不过滤.
没有内存,支持代理从之前的会话中看不到任何东西,所以对话并不依赖于格式.
因此,仅附件行重新使用附录E的内存和无记忆运行。
基于 retrieved-based no-memory 的行与仅附加的行完全相同,因为两者都保留相同的摘要,且基于更新的无记忆记录是通过将仅附加的无记忆运行的笔录传递给Mem0按会话顺序来构建的.
新的运行是两种新格式的内存和响应侧条件,以及仅附件格式的响应侧条件.

blocks.en: Table 6: Memory raises leakage in every format, and the response-side instruction brings it to about the no-memory level. Daggers are relative to memory in the same format.
blocks.zh: 表6:内存在每一种格式中都提高了渗漏度,响应侧指示使其接近无记忆水平. 匕首与内存相对,格式相同.

blocks.en:
Memory raises leakage over no memory in all three formats and both models, together with helpfulness and coherence ( Table 6 ).
The gap is smallest with retrieval, where the agent sees only the summaries most similar to the current turn.
Consulting less of the history during dialogue thus gives a smaller gap, although inference reads the same record as in the append-only format.
Update-based memory gives a gap close to that of the append-only format, although Mem0 consolidates, overwrites, and deletes what it stores.
In every format, the response-side instruction cuts mentions to or below the no-memory share, below it with append-only memory as with Claude Sonnet 5 on the user side, and brings leakage to about the no-memory level.
With Mistral Small 4 on the user side, it lowers helpfulness and coherence slightly in every format, unlike with Claude Sonnet 5 ( Table 3 ), but keeps most of the quality gain of memory.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: Appendix I Stronger Inference Models
blocks.zh: 附录一 加强推断模型

blocks.en:
In the main experiment, the party that learns about the user is the support model itself ( Section 2.2 ).
A party that obtains the record may instead use a stronger model, so we repeat attribute inference on the existing records with two inference models from developers whose models play no other role in this study.
No dialogue is regenerated, and each inference model reads the same records as the support model did, with the prompt and candidate lists of Appendix N.11 .
Because such a party is unconstrained, reasoning is enabled for both inference models (Kimi K3 always reasons), and other generation parameters are defaults.
The inference models are Gemini 3.1 Pro ( gemini-3.1-pro-preview ) and Kimi K3 ( kimi-k3 ).
blocks.zh:
在主要实验中,了解用户的一方是支持模型本身(第2.2节).
获得记录的一方可能会使用更强的模型,因此我们用开发者的两个推论模型重复对现有记录的属性推论,这些模型在本研究中没有其他作用.
没有再生成对话,每个推论模型都读取了与支持模型相同的记录,附录N.11的即时名单和候选人名单。
由于这样的一方不受约束,所以可以同时为推论模型(Kimi K3总是原因)进行推理,其他的生成参数都是默认的.
推论模型有双子座3.1 Pro(双子座3.1-pro-review)和Kimi K3(kimi-k3).

blocks.en:

To test whether the response-side instruction still helps against a stronger party, we also use the final checkpoint of the response-side runs of Appendix M , for Qwen3.8-27B and V4-Flash.
Empirical leakage, weights, and intervals are as in Section 2.6 and Appendix C .

我们使用未过滤内存的最终检查点(s = 80 s = 80)以及所有四个支持模型和所有配置的无记忆运行.

经验性渗漏、重量和间隔与第2.6节和附录C相同。

blocks.en: Table 11: A stronger inference model recovers more attributes in both settings, and the gap between memory and no memory remains. Leakage at the final checkpoint of unfiltered runs.
blocks.zh: 表11 较强的推论模型在两种设置中恢复更多的属性,内存与无内存之间的差距仍然存在. 未过滤跑道最后检查站漏水.

blocks.en: Table 12: Against stronger inference models, the response-side instruction still brings leakage to about the no-memory level. Daggers are relative to memory for the same inference model.
blocks.zh: 表12:与较强的推论模型相比,反应侧指示仍然使渗漏达到大约无模拟水平。 匕首是相对于同一推论模型的内存.

blocks.en:
Both inference models recover more attributes than the support models do, in both settings and for every support model ( Table 11 ).
The gap between memory and no memory remains for every support model and is at least as large as with the support model itself.
The main experiment thus understates rather than overstates what a record reveals to a party that obtains it.
The two inference models agree closely with each other, and their advantage over the support models reflects both a stronger model and enabled reasoning, which we do not separate.
Against either inference model, the response-side instruction still brings leakage to about the no-memory level ( Table 12 ), so its effect does not depend on a weak inference party.
blocks.zh:
两种推论模型在设置和每个支持模型中恢复的属性都超过支持模型的属性(表11)。
每一个支持模式的内存和没有内存之间的差距依然存在,至少与支持模式本身一样大.
因此,主要实验低估而不是夸大记录向获得记录的一方揭示的内容。
这两种推论模型相互间非常一致,它们相对于支持模型的优势既反映了一个更强大的模型,也反映了能够推理,我们没有将其分开.
与任何一种推论模型相反,反应方指示仍然使渗漏达到大约无推论水平(表12),因此其效果并不依赖于弱推论方.

年龄和收入使用主要实验的波段,性别、教育、职业和婚姻状况使用其类别,从300个简介中选取相同的职业候选人名单。

blocks.en:
Each participant completed 30 sessions with DeepSeek V4-Flash-0731 as the support agent, through a chat interface connected to our memory pipeline.
The support model, the support-agent summary, and the inference prompt are those of the main experiment.
Participants chose their own requests from matters in their actual lives and ended each session themselves, within T = 10 T=10 turns.
Memory access alternates in blocks of five sessions.
In a memory-on block, the support agent receives all accumulated summaries, and in a memory-off block it receives none and its context is reset between sessions.
Four participants started with a memory-on block and four with a memory-off block, so that the first five sessions, in which the agent has the least to draw on, are not all of one kind.
Participants were told that the assistant’s access to earlier conversations would vary, but not when.
Attributes are inferred from the accumulated summaries after each session with the prompt of Appendix N.11 , restricted to the eight attributes, with the number of items in the prompt changed accordingly.
As in the main experiment, predictions are not added to memory.
Each participant marked each prediction as correct or incorrect.
For age and income, a prediction was correct if their true value falls in the predicted band, for occupation if their work falls in the predicted category, and otherwise if it matched exactly.
An answer of “undetermined” is incorrect.
For each attribute predicted correctly after session 30, participants also indicated whether they recalled stating it.

每位参与者通过连接我们内存管道的聊天界面,完成了30场由DeepSeek V4-Flash-0731作为辅助代理的会话.
支持模型,支持-代理总结,以及推论的即时是主实验的模型.
与会者从实际生活中的事项中选择了自己的请求,并在T=10 T=10轮之内结束了每期会议。

四位参与者以内存-on块开始,四位则以内存-off块开始,因此前五届,其中代理最不需要借鉴,并不是全部都是一种.
与会者被告知,该助理接触先前对话的机会会有所不同,但不会是何时。

和主实验一样,预测不加入内存.
每个参与者将每项预测标为正确或不正确。
就年龄和收入而言,如果它们的真实价值在预测的波段内下降,如果它们的工作属于预测的类别,或者如果它与预测的类别完全相符,则预测是正确的。

对于30次会议之后正确预测的每个属性,与会者还表明他们是否回顾指出这一点。

将每个参与者与与其起始区块匹配的运行进行比较。

blocks.en:
After session 30, three to six of the eight attributes are marked correct ( Table 13 ), although participants were instructed not to state any of them. G on G^{\mathrm{on}} exceeds G off G^{\mathrm{off}} for all eight participants (one-sided sign test, p = 0.004 p=0.004 ), in the same direction and of similar size as in simulation, and six of the eight had at least one correctly inferred attribute that they did not recall stating.
As in the branching analysis, attributes become inferable mostly while the agent has access to memory.
With eight participants, the pilot indicates the direction of the effect rather than its size.

To check the response → \to user link of the loop directly, the same two annotators of Appendix D.1 independently labeled every support-agent response in the participants’ 30 sessions for mentions of the eight attributes (references, presuppositions, and confirmation questions, Appendix K.2 ) and, for each mention, the reaction in the next user turn as affirmation, correction, refusal, or no correction.
Disagreements were adjudicated by a third annotator, as in Appendix D.1 , and the participants’ consent covered this analysis of their conversation logs.
Unlike the validation of Appendix D , no LLM labels are involved, and agreement is between the two annotators before adjudication.
Annotators judged from the dialogue alone.

为了直接检查回覆 ~\\ 用户链接循环, 附录 D.1 的两位注释员在参与者的 30 个会话中将每个支持代理响应单独标注为提及 8 个属性(参考,预设, 和确认问题, 附录 K.2 ) , 对于每个引用, 下个用户转动时的反应为确认, 更正, 拒绝, 或者没有更正 。

blocks.en: Table 14: Participants, like the simulated users, mostly left mentions uncorrected, and affirmed them more often despite the instruction. Shares of labeled reactions are in parentheses.
blocks.zh: 表14:参与者与模拟用户一样,大多是左侧未更正的,尽管有指示,但更经常地确认。 括号内为标签反应的分享.

blocks.en:
Participants reacted to mentions much as the simulated users did ( Table 14 ).
Most reactions left the mentioned value uncorrected, in memory-on and memory-off sessions alike, and memory-on sessions contained about four times as many mentions.
Participants affirmed mentioned values more often than the filtered simulated users, although they had been instructed not to state their attributes, and corrected them somewhat more often.
Refusals were rare in both.
The simulation may therefore understate how often the response → \to user link turns a mention into a disclosure, since the filter removes affirmations that the instruction alone does not.
Annotators agreed closely on both mentions and reactions, with Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.84 and 0.76 between the two annotators before adjudication, over all labeled items.
blocks.zh:
与会者的反应与模拟用户一样多(表14)。
大多数反应使得上述价值没有被修正,无论是内存还是外存,而且内存的内存都包含大约四倍于提及的次数。
与会者比被过滤的模拟用户更经常地申明其数值,尽管已指示他们不要说明其属性,并更经常地加以更正。
两次拒绝都是罕见的。
因此,模拟可能低估了用户链接的响应 \\\ 将提及转换为披露的频率,因为过滤器删除了指令本身不是的确认.
注释者在提及和反应上都非常一致,科恩在判决前在两个注释者之间就所有标注的项目分别给出0.84和0.76的\kappa。

blocks.en: Appendix K Annotation of Responses, Reactions, and Records
blocks.zh: 附录K 答复、反应和记录的说明

blocks.en: This appendix supports Section 3.3 , and its definitions are also used in Appendix L .
blocks.zh: 本附录支持第3.3节,其定义也在附录L中使用。

blocks.en: K.1 Scope and Inputs
blocks.zh: K.1 范围和投入

blocks.en:
The annotator model and the editing model are Mistral Small 4 (model ID in Appendix E ), which generated none of the annotated text.
There are two annotations.
blocks.zh:
注释器模型和编辑模型是Mistral Small 4(附录E中的模型ID),它没有产生任何附加说明的文本.
有两个说明。

blocks.en:
It covers the unfiltered runs of all four support models and all profiles, in sessions 40 , 45 , … , 80 40,45,\ldots,80 and in session 1, which serves as a placebo because the memory is then empty and the memory block is omitted, so both settings receive identical inputs.
For each support-agent response, it labels the mentions of each attribute and their source.
For each disclosure flagged by the judges, it labels the trigger and specificity (Appendix N.13 ).
Which attributes are disclosed is determined by the judges, as in Table 10 , not by the annotator.
Each call receives the ground-truth profile, the current-session dialogue up to and including the annotated message, and the user summary through the preceding session.
blocks.zh:
它涵盖了所有四个支持模型和所有配置图的未过滤运行,在会话40,45,...,80 40,45,\ldots,80和会话1中作为安慰剂,因为内存随后是空的,并且省略了内存块,所以两个设置都收到相同的输入.
对于每个支持代理响应,它标记每个属性及其源的引用.
对于法官标注的每一项披露,都标注触发和具体性(附录N.13)。
如表10所示,哪些属性由法官决定,而不是由注释员决定。
每一次通话都收到地面实况简介、直至并包括附加说明的信息的当前会议对话,以及上次会议的用户摘要。

blocks.en:
It covers every session of the unfiltered and direct-filter memory runs for 100 profiles per support model, drawn at random from the 300, and sessions 40 , 45 , … , 80 40,45,\ldots,80 of the corresponding no-memory runs.
It is also applied to the unfiltered runs of Appendix E , and to its direct-filter memory runs for the refusal analysis.
For these runs, whose user agent is Mistral Small 4, the annotator is Claude Sonnet 5.
Each call receives the transcript of one session, its support-agent summary, the ground-truth profile, the user summary through the preceding session, and the support-agent memory through the preceding session, and returns labeled mentions, reactions, and records per attribute (Appendix N.14 ).
User-turn forms reuse the judge outputs and specificity labels of the turn-level annotation, giving a value if flagged with value specificity and a cue only otherwise.
blocks.zh:
它涵盖了每个未过滤和直接过滤器内存的每次会话,每个支持模型可随机抽取100个剖面图,从300个模型中抽取40个,45个,.,80个40,45个,\ldots,80个对应的无记忆运行.
它也应用于附录E的未过滤运行,并应用于其用于拒绝分析的直过滤存储运行.
对于这些运行,其用户代理为Mistral Small 4,注释员为克劳德·索内5.
每一次呼叫都收到一个会话的笔录,其支持代理摘要,地面-真实概况,用户摘要通过上一个会话,支持代理内存通过上一个会话,并返回标注的提及,反应和记录每个属性(附录N.14 ).
用户转动表重用裁判员的输出和转动级注释的特异性标签,如果标注有具体值,则给出一个值,但提示另作说明。

blocks.en: K.2 Definitions
blocks.zh: K.2 定义

blocks.en:
An explicit reference states a value of the attribute for the user.
A presupposition does not state a value but tailors the response in a way that is appropriate only for some values.
A confirmation question asks the user to confirm a specific value.
An open question asks about the attribute without proposing one and is not a mention.
References and presuppositions are marked correct or incorrect against the profile.
blocks.zh:
明确的引用为用户表示属性值.
预设并不表示一个值,而是以仅适合某些值的方式调整响应.
一个确认问题要求用户确认一个特定值.
一个未决问题是在没有提出属性的情况下提出属性问题,而不是提的。
参考文献和预言对照剖面图标出正确或不正确.

blocks.en:
The source of a mention is the current session if the value is stated or implied earlier in the current session, an earlier session if it appears only in what was said or recorded in earlier sessions, and neither otherwise.
In no-memory runs, where the agent has no access to earlier sessions, a value that appears only there is counted as neither, so the earlier-session source is zero by construction.
The turn-level annotation does not receive the support-agent memory, so there an earlier session covers only what the user said.
The session-level annotation distinguishes earlier_user and earlier_record , the value appearing only in what the user said or only in what the support agent recorded in earlier sessions, and together they make up the earlier-session source.
blocks.zh:
如果本届会议早些时候说明或暗示了这一价值,那么提及的来源是本届会议;如果以前届会仅出现在前几届会议的言论或记录中,则指早先届会,而不是其他届会。
在无映射运行中,当代理无法访问早期会话时,只显示的值被算作无映射,所以通过构建,早期会话源为零.
转动级注释没有获得支持代理内存,所以之前的会话只涵盖用户所说的话.
会话级别注释区分了更早的_user和更早的_record ,该值只出现在用户所说的话中或者只出现在支持代理在更早的会话中记录的内容中,它们共同构成更早的会话来源.

blocks.en:
Specificity is the value itself, a range, or a cue only, and is labeled by the annotator independently of the judges.
A range stated outright can be flagged by the direct judge, which counts statements coarser than the attribute’s categories, and still be labeled a range, which is why direct-flagged attribute–turn pairs slightly outnumber value-level disclosures (Appendix K.3 ).
An attribute is disclosed at the value level for the first time in a turn if it is flagged there with value specificity and has no earlier value-level disclosure among the accepted user turns of the run.
It was hinted earlier if it had been disclosed earlier as a range or a cue, and not hinted earlier otherwise.
blocks.zh:
具体性是数值本身,范围,或仅指提示,由注释者独立于评委来标注.
直接法官可以直截了当地标出一个范围,它把声明比属性的类别更紧凑,并且仍然贴上一个范围的标签,这就是为什么直接标记的属性-转动对略多于价值级的披露(附录K.3)。
如果一个属性在数值级别上首次被标出具体值,且未在运行过程中被接受的用户转弯中提前披露值级别,则该属性将首次在数值级别上披露。
如果它早先被披露为一个范围或一个提示,而不是早些时候被暗示。

blocks.en:
The trigger of a flagged disclosure is assigned in two steps.
First, the response annotations determine whether the preceding support-agent response contains a mention of the same attribute, and otherwise whether it contains an open question about it.
If it contains a mention, the annotator judges only whether the user turn affirms or elaborates the proposed value or replaces it, and the disclosure is then an affirmation or a correction.
If it contains only an open question, the disclosure is an answer to a question, and otherwise it is unsolicited.
blocks.zh:
标记披露的触发器分两个步骤指定。
首先,反应说明确定之前的支持-代理反应是否包含有相同属性的提法,否则它是否包含一个关于它的未决问题.
如果其中包含提及,则注释员只判断用户是否转而确认或阐述拟议价值或替换价值,而披露则是一种确认或更正。
如果只包含一个未决问题,则披露是对一个问题的答案,否则即是主动提出的。

blocks.en:
A reaction is labeled for each user turn that follows a response mentioning an attribute.
It is an affirmation if the user states or confirms the proposed value, a correction if the user replaces it, a refusal if the user declines to discuss the attribute or asks the assistant not to assume or use it, without stating, confirming, or replacing the value, and no correction otherwise.
A turn that declines to discuss an attribute but also states, confirms, or replaces its value is labeled by that content.
blocks.zh:
每个用户在答复中提及属性后,都会给反应贴上标签。
它是一种确认,如果用户声明或确认拟议值,如果用户替换该值,如果用户拒绝讨论属性或要求助理不假设或使用该属性,而不声明,确认或替换该值,则是一种更正,不另作更正.
拒绝讨论一个属性,但也声明、确认或取代其价值的转弯,则被该内容贴上标签。

blocks.en:
For each summary and attribute, the record is a value if the summary states a value for the user, a cue if it narrows down the value without stating it, and nothing otherwise.
Its source is a user statement if a user turn of the session states the value, a user cue if a user turn only narrows it down, a user refusal if the record reflects only that the user declined to discuss the attribute, and an uncorrected agent value if the value appears only in a support-agent response and no later user turn in the session contradicts it.
A refusal does not count as contradicting it.
Recorded values are marked correct or incorrect against the profile.
blocks.zh:
对于每个摘要和属性,如果摘要为用户表示一个值,如果它缩小了数值而不说明,则记录是一个值,没有其他的。
其来源是用户声明,如果会话的用户转折表示值,如果用户转弯只缩小其范围,则用户提示;如果记录只反映用户拒绝讨论属性,则用户拒绝;如果该值只出现在支持代理响应中,且不会在会话中后用户转弯,则未更正代理值.
拒绝并不等于与之相矛盾。
所记录的数值相对于配置文件被标记为正确或不正确.

blocks.en:
A cycle on attribute a a is one pass through the loop, matched from three events in order, namely a record of a a in the summary of session s s , a response in a later session s ′ s^{\prime} that mentions a a with an earlier session as its only source, and a record of a a in the summary of s ′ s^{\prime} whose source is the reaction to that response.
Each response opens at most one cycle per attribute, matched to the most recent record of a a .
The form of a cycle is the combination of the source of the first record and the reaction.
Cycles closed by a correction are counted separately and enter Table 21 .
blocks.zh:
属性 a 的循环是一个循环,通过三个事件,顺序是:会议 s 的总结中的记录; 以后会议 s 的响应 s ' s prime ,其中提到以较早的会议作为唯一来源; 以及 s → s prime 的总结中的记录,其来源是对该反应的反应。
每个响应每个属性最多打开一个周期,与最近记录的1个属性相匹配。
循环的形式是第一记录的来源和反应的结合.
经更正关闭的周期分别计算并填入表21。

blocks.en: K.3 Measures
blocks.zh: K.3 措施

blocks.en:
In Table 1 and Table 15 , rows other than session 1 use sessions 40 , 45 , … , 80 40,45,\ldots,80 .
Turn rates are percentages of user turns with a disclosure, standardized over turn positions unless marked unstandardized.
Later turns are standardized to the pooled distribution of turn positions 2, 3, 4, and 5 or later over both settings (0.28, 0.26, 0.22, and 0.24).
Response and source rows are percentages of responses with at least one instance.
Trigger and specificity rows count flagged disclosures per 1,000 user words, and first value-level rows are per 100 user turns.
A flagged disclosure is an attribute–turn pair flagged by at least one judge, so a turn can contain several, unlike the flagged turns of Table 10 .
In Table 17 , user-turn rows count flagged disclosures per 1,000 user words, record rows are fractions of summary–attribute pairs, response rows are fractions of responses with at least one instance, and reaction rows are shares of labeled reactions.
blocks.zh:
在表1和表15中,除第1场外,其他各行使用第40、第45、第80、第40、第45、第80页。
转弯率是指用户转弯时有披露的百分率,标准化的转弯位置,除非有明显的不标准化.
后来的转弯被标准化为转弯位置2、3、4和5的集合分配,或后来在两种场合(0.28、0.26、0.22和0.24)的组合分配。
答复和源行是至少一次答复的百分比。
触发和特异性行数为每1,000个用户字的标记披露,第一个值级行数为每100个用户转折.
标注的披露是至少一位法官标注的属性-转动对,因此转动可以包含多个,与表10标注的转动不同。
在表17中,用户-转动行数为每1000个用户字的标记披露,记录行数是摘要-属性对数的分数,响应行数是至少一个实例的响应分数,反应行数是标签反应的分数.

blocks.en:
Because the specificity labels carry the value-level results, we compare them with the direct judge, which does not depend on the annotator.
Of value-level disclosures, 95% are also flagged by the direct judge in both settings, and direct-flagged attribute–turn pairs rise from 5.2 to 6.9 per 1,000 user words with memory (a difference whose 95% bootstrap interval excludes zero), in line with the increase in value-level disclosures from 4.4 to 6.4.
blocks.zh:
因为特异性标签带有值级结果,所以我们把它们与直接判断者进行比较,而直接判断者并不依赖于注释者.
在价值层面的披露中,95%也由直接裁判员在两种情况下标出,直接标记的属性-转动对数从每1 000个有内存的用户字数的5.2个增加到6.9个(95%的拖网间隔不包括零),这与价值层面的披露从4.4个增加到6.4个相一致。

blocks.en: K.4 Response Replay and Reference Removal
blocks.zh: K.4 回复和删除参考

blocks.en:
We sample support-agent responses from unfiltered memory sessions 40 , 45 , … , 80 40,45,\ldots,80 that are followed by a user turn, stratified by whether the response contains a mention, with n ref n_{\mathrm{ref}} per support model that contain one and n noref n_{\mathrm{noref}} that do not.
For every sampled response, we construct the original and a regeneration from the same within-session context without the memory block.
For responses with a mention, we also construct a version in which the editing model removes every mention and leaves the rest unchanged, and for responses without one, the removal version equals the original.
In the reverse direction, we sample n rev n_{\mathrm{rev}} no-memory responses and regenerate each with the memory block filled by the run’s own record m s − 1 m_{s-1} .
For each version, we sample the next user turn L L times from the user agent with its original inputs and apply both judges, and the evaluator rates the response itself for helpfulness and coherence.
We use n ref = 400 n_{\mathrm{ref}}=400 , n noref = 100 n_{\mathrm{noref}}=100 , n rev = 200 n_{\mathrm{rev}}=200 , and L = 3 L=3 .
Of memory responses in sessions 40 , 45 , … , 80 40,45,\ldots,80 , 54% contain at least one mention.
This share, estimated from the full annotation, is used to reweight the two strata.
The next user turn is generated by Claude Sonnet 5 with the prompt, profile, request, user summary, and dialogue context of the original turn, and both judges are applied to each sample with the inputs used for Table 10 .
The evaluator rates each response version with the prompts of Appendix N.12 and the same inputs as for the original response.
Intervals for the reweighted estimates resample profiles within each stratum and treat the share as fixed.
For memory responses with a mention, regenerating without memory lowers both helpfulness and coherence, whereas removing only the mentions leaves helpfulness unchanged, with an interval that includes zero, and lowers coherence by less than half as much as regenerating without memory.
blocks.zh:
我们抽样了来自未过滤内存的40、45、......、80、40、45、\ldots、80的辅助代理响应,然后是用户转弯,按响应中是否包含提及进行分级排序,每个支持模型包含一个和n Noref n\ mathrm{noref}没有提及。
对于每一个抽样的反应,我们从相同的会内上下文构建原始和再生,没有内存块.
对于有提及的答复,我们还构建了一个版本,其中编辑模型删除了每一个提及,其余部分保持不变,对于没有提及的答复,删除版本等于原件.
在相反方向,我们抽样n rev n_{\mathrm{rev}}} 无记忆响应, 并用存储块重生,
对于每个版本,我们用用户代理的原始投入对下一个用户的L转L时间进行抽样,并应用两个判断,评价者将反应本身评为有用性和一致性.
我们使用n ref=400 n_{\mathrm{ref}}=400,n Noref=100 n_{\mathrm{noref}}=100,n rev=200 n_{\mathrm{rev}}=200,L=3 L=3.
在40,45,...,80,40,45,\ldots,80,54%的内存回复中至少包含一个提及.
从完整的注解中估计的这一份额用于重新加权两个阶层。
下一个用户回合由Claude Sonnet 5生成,包含原回合的快速,配置,请求,用户摘要和对话背景,两个法官都与表10所用的投入一起应用于每个样本.
评价人员对每个答复版本的评分,采用附录N.12的提示以及与原始答复相同的投入。
重新加权估计在各层内重新取样剖面的间隔,并将该份额视为固定的。
对于有提及内容的内存响应,没有内存的再生成会降低帮助性和一致性,而只删除提及内容则会保留无影响内容不变,间隔包含0,将一致性降低不到没有内存的再生成的一半.

blocks.en:
The editing model (Appendix N.16 ) receives the response and its annotated mentions, and deletes or neutralizes them while keeping all other content.
An edit is accepted if the response annotation (Appendix N.15 ) finds no remaining instance and the content check (Appendix N.17 ) returns that content is kept and none is added.
Otherwise it is regenerated, up to 3 times.
Edited responses are 87% of the original length on average.
blocks.zh:
编辑模型(Appendix N.16 )收到回复及其注释提及,删除或中和,同时保留所有其他内容.
如果响应注释(附录N.15)找不到剩余实例,且内容检查(附录N.17)返回内容保存且不添加,则接受编辑.
否则再生成,最多3次.
编辑的答复平均为原长度的87%.

blocks.zh: 表15: 表1的全部细目 转动,响应,和源行为百分数,其他单位在附录K.3中给出,行可能因四舍五入而不能完全总和.

blocks.en: Table 17: Every link occurs in explicit and implicit forms, and under the direct filter the implicit forms dominate. Units are given in Appendix K.3 .
blocks.zh: 表17:每个链接都以明示和默示形式出现,在直接过滤下,默示形式占主导地位。 单位见附录K.3。

blocks.en: Appendix L Loop Breaking, Errors, and Refusals
blocks.zh: 附录 循环 断开、错误和拒绝

blocks.en: This appendix supports Section 3.4 and uses the definitions of Appendix K.2 .
blocks.zh: 本附录支持第3.4节,并使用附录K.2的定义.

blocks.en: L.1 Loop Breaking
blocks.zh: L.1 循环中断

blocks.en:
Attributes are grouped into clusters of strongly dependent attributes by single-linkage grouping of attributes with r a ​ b ≥ 0.1 r_{ab}\geq 0.1 (Appendix A.3 ).
For each profile and support model, the clusters are assigned uniformly at random to three groups, with group sizes in clusters differing by at most one.
In every response of sessions 41 to 50, the editing model removes all mentions of attributes in the first group (all removed) and only references and confirmation questions about attributes in the second (explicit removed).
The third is untouched and serves as the control.
Under the direct filter, no link of the loop is then explicit for the explicit-removed group, either on the user side or in the response.
blocks.zh:
属性按属性的单链接分组组合为强烈依赖属性的集群,属性组合为r a b → 0.1 r_{ab}\geq 0.1(附录A.3 ).
对于每个剖面图和支持模型,分组都统一随机分配给三个组,分组大小最多因一个而异.
在每次第41至50会话的回复中,编辑模型都会删除第一组中所有提及属性的内容(全部删除),只有提及和确认关于第二组属性的问题(明确删除).
第三个是未触及的,并起到控制的作用。
在直接滤波器下,对于明确删除的组,无论是在用户一方还是在响应中,循环的链接都没有明确.

blocks.en:
The unfiltered and direct-filter runs branch from the memory runs of the main experiment at b = 40 b=40 with the same requests after b b .
Under the direct filter, a sampled user turn that the direct judge flags is resampled as in Appendix N.5 .
Editing and acceptance follow Appendix K.4 , with the instances to remove restricted by group.
An edited response that fails the acceptance check three times is replaced by a regeneration without the memory block.
Effects are differences between attributes of an edited group and untouched attributes of the same profile, excluding untouched attributes that are weak neighbors of an edited attribute.
Without filtering, the memory arm of the branching analysis at b = 40 b=40 serves as an additional reference.
All user turns of the two branched runs, and of their pre-branch sessions 1 to 40, carry the specificity labels of Appendix K.1 , so that first disclosures are defined over the whole run.
Without filtering, outcomes use first value-level disclosures.
Under the direct filter, which removes value-level disclosures, they use first cue-level disclosures, that is, the first user turn of the run in which the inferable judge flags the attribute.

An incorrect value is carried forward if a response presupposes, states, or asks to confirm an incorrect value with an earlier session as its only source.
It is entrenched if it is not corrected, is recorded as an uncorrected agent value, and is the inference prediction at the next checkpoint.
A refusal counts as not correcting the value, so a refused value can also be recorded uncorrected.
In Table 21 , the first row is a share of responses, indented rows are shares of the values carried forward, and “of which” rows are shares of the row above.

blocks.en: L.3 Refusals

blocks.en:
The user agent receives no instruction to refuse, so refusals arise only as it follows its persona and, under the direct filter, the instruction not to refer to its attributes.
Refusals and their records are reported with the other reactions and records in Table 17 , Table 18 , and Table 21 .
To test whether a refusal itself carries information about the value, we fix, before labeling, a set of values for five attributes, namely not covered by health insurance ( HICOV ), not a citizen ( CIT ), with a disability ( DIS ), unemployed ( ESR ), and personal income in the lowest two bands ( PINCP ).
For each of these attributes, we compare the rate of refusal between profiles whose true value is in the set and profiles whose value is not, and, among sessions in which the attribute was mentioned, the share predicted correctly at the next checkpoint with and without a refusal, together with the difference in this shift between the two groups ( Table 22 ).
Refusals are chosen by the user agent rather than assigned, so these comparisons are associations, and which values it declines to discuss reflects the user model’s own view of what is sensitive, which need not match that of human users.
With Mistral Small 4 as the user agent, refusals are also more frequent for values in the set, for four of the five attributes and in the same direction for income ( Table 23 ).

拒绝及其记录与表17、表18和表21中的其他反应和记录一并报告。
为了检验拒绝本身是否包含有关该价值的信息,我们在贴标签之前确定一套关于五个属性的数值,即健康保险(HICOV)、非公民(CIT)、残疾(综合安全分遣队)、失业(ESR)和个人收入最低的两段(PINCP)。
对于其中每一个属性,我们比较了真正值在集中的配置和价值不在的配置之间的拒绝率,以及在提到属性的会话中,在下一个检查站和没有拒绝的情况下正确预测的份额,以及两个组之间的这一变化的差异(表22)。

blocks.en:
We use the released implementation of Staab et al. (2025) as is, including its prompts.
It alternates an inference step, which identifies the attributes a text reveals and the cues that reveal them, with a rewriting step, which removes those cues while keeping the rest of the text.
The number of rounds and the models are those of the released configuration.
The attributes it protects are the 24 attributes of 𝒜 \mathcal{A} , which replace the attribute set of Staab et al. (2025) , and nothing else is changed.
In user-side anonymization, it is applied to every user turn, including the opening request, after the user agent writes it and before the support agent sees it.
The anonymized turn replaces the original in the dialogue, the support-agent summary, and the user summary, as rejected candidates do under the filters.
In write-time anonymization, it is applied to each support-agent summary before the summary is appended to memory, and the dialogue itself is unchanged.
In both, inference reads the memory as stored, so user-side anonymization changes what the support agent sees and what is recorded, and write-time anonymization changes only what is recorded.

blocks.en: N.5 Resampling Procedure
blocks.zh: N.5 恢复程序

blocks.en:
Filtering applies to every candidate user turn, including the opening request, and the judges receive the accepted user turns and support-agent responses so far in the session.
A rejected candidate is resampled with the same persona, request, user summary, and dialogue context.
From the second candidate on, the prompt also states that the previous message was not sent because it disclosed an attribute and asks the user agent to write it again (Appendix N.4 ).
Neither the rejected text, the verdict, nor this instruction is added to the dialogue context.
Rejected candidates do not count toward the turn limit and do not appear in the transcript or in either summary.
Under both filters, every turn obtained a passing candidate within at most nine resamplings.
Human annotators rated the naturalness of 100 randomly sampled turns accepted after resampling and 100 accepted at the first candidate on a five-point scale, and the two did not differ significantly (Wilcoxon rank-sum test, p > 0.05 p>0.05 ).
Support-agent responses are not filtered.
